verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so in-client calendar viewing, invite responses, and event creation are a fair axis, but the pack has no first-party evidence of any of them. The only calendar mention is that external AI apps can act on your calendar through Missive's MCP server, which is a different capability and does not show a calendar inside the client. The 'Syncs with Office 365 and Google' line refers to contacts.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client
